# HANNCREST — Full Text Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive technical specification, application documentation, privacy architecture, pricing models, and FAQ index for HANNCREST macOS applications.

## 1. About HANNCREST
- **Studio Name**: HANNCREST
- **Website**: https://www.hanncrest.com/
- **Publisher Email**: contact@hanncrest.com
- **Target Operating System**: macOS 13.0 Ventura, macOS 14 Sonoma, macOS 15 Sequoia, and later.
- **Architectures Supported**: Universal binaries for Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4) and Intel x86_64.
- **Tech Stack**: 100% native Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, Metal, CoreML, Apple Neural Engine. No Electron, no web wrappers, no Chromium.

### Guiding Principles
1. **Privacy Absolute**: No user tracking, no telemetry, no Google Analytics, no Mixpanel, no crash uploaders unless initiated by the user. No user accounts or login required.
2. **Local-First & Offline**: All metrics calculation, AI text rewriting, disk indexing, and speech recognition occur strictly on local CPU/GPU/Neural Engine silicon.
3. **No Subscriptions**: Generous free tiers with perpetual one-time purchase licenses. Buy once, own forever.

---

## 2. Product Catalog & Technical Deep Dives

### App 1: Vitals
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/vitals/
- **Tagline**: Your Mac's vital signs in the menu bar.
- **Category**: System Monitor & Diagnostics Utility.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - **Menu Bar Monitor**: Real-time stats for CPU utilization, RAM usage & memory pressure, GPU compute load, network upload/download throughput, thermal levels & fan speeds, internal battery state of charge, and connected Bluetooth peripheral battery levels (AirPods, Magic Mouse, Magic Keyboard, Bluetooth headsets).
  - **Local LLM Intelligence**: Automatically detects running local LLM inference engines (Ollama, LM Studio, Llama.cpp, Apple Intelligence) and measures real-time tokens-per-second inference speed, model name, and GPU VRAM footprint.
  - **30-Day Historical Logging**: On-device lightweight time-series logging to spot memory leaks, thermal throttling triggers, and runaway background processes over time.
  - **Storage & S.M.A.R.T. Health**: Real-time SSD wear levels, TBW (terabytes written), read/write endurance, and drive health indicators.
  - **Battery Vampire Detector**: While on battery, flags a single process that has sustained heavy CPU load past a configurable threshold and duration, then offers one-tap Tame (throttles it to a low-priority background band) or Force Quit, plus an actionable system notification with the same two actions. System-critical processes are excluded.
  - **Crash Watcher**: Intercepts macOS crash logs and kernel panics, translating complex stack traces into actionable plain-English explanations.
  - **Desktop Widget**: Live configurable desktop widget for continuous glanceable monitoring.
- **Pricing**: Free tier forever for core monitoring. Vitals Pro is a one-time purchase of $9.99 USD following a 14-day full-featured free trial.

### App 2: Breeze
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/breeze/
- **Tagline**: Clean up & speed up your Mac.
- **Category**: Storage Optimization & Maintenance Utility.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - **Smart Scan & Health Score**: Unified health diagnostic that identifies junk files, cache bloat, memory leaks, and disk space bottlenecks with a single click.
  - **True App Uninstaller**: Thoroughly removes macOS application bundles along with orphaned preferences (`~/Library/Preferences`), Application Support directories, caches (`~/Library/Caches`), daemons, and launch agents.
  - **Visual Storage Map**: Interactive folder hierarchy explorer enabling instant visual identification of large directories and storage hogs.
  - **Duplicate & Similar File Finder**: Byte-by-byte duplicate detector and visual similarity scanner for duplicate photos and downloaded assets.
  - **Developer Junk Purger**: Specialized cleanups for Xcode DerivedData, simulator runtimes, npm `node_modules` caches, Gradle caches, CocoaPods caches, Docker VM remnants, and Python virtual environment bloat.
  - **Safety Philosophy**: Review-first policy. Deletions move files safely to the macOS Trash (`~/.Trash`) rather than executing permanent destructive unlinks. System and SIP-protected files are strictly bypassed.
- **Pricing**: Free tier includes Smart Scan, Health Score, Storage Map, and basic uninstaller. Breeze Pro is a one-time purchase of $19.99 USD.

### App 3: StealthShare
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/stealthshare/
- **Tagline**: Screen privacy for screen sharing.
- **Category**: Privacy & Presentation Utility.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - **App Window Masking**: Blurs or masks designated sensitive application windows (Slack, Apple Messages, WhatsApp, Mail, 1Password, Notes) during presentations and screen share sessions.
  - **Audience Separation**: The presenter retains full visibility to work while viewers on Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack huddle, or FaceTime see only an opaque or blurred privacy mask.
  - **Desktop Cloak & Wallpaper Neutralizer**: Temporarily hides desktop icons and widgets and swaps the active wallpaper to a clean neutral background with one click.
  - **Notification Hold**: Automatic suppression of banner notifications and sound alerts during active sharing sessions via macOS Focus / Shortcuts integration.
  - **Auto-Arm Intelligence**: Automatically enables privacy shields upon detecting active video call processes or camera/mic usage, or 60 seconds prior to scheduled calendar events.
  - **Zero Recording Architecture**: StealthShare does not capture, record, encode, or transmit video frames. It relies purely on native window coordinate masking.
- **Pricing**: 14-day free trial with all features enabled. One-time purchase of $14.99 USD with lifetime updates.

### App 4: Aura
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/aura/
- **Tagline**: Offline AI text assistant for Mac.
- **Category**: Productivity & AI Writing Utility.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - **In-Place Transformation**: Select text anywhere on macOS and press Shift-Command-P (`⇧⌘P`) to stream rewritten, proofread, or summarized text directly into the active application.
  - **Rewrite Modes**: Proofread grammar & typos, Clarify tone, Shorten/condense, Expand, Make Professional, Make Casual, and Custom Prompts.
  - **100% On-Device Engine**: Leverages Apple Intelligence on macOS Sequoia/future releases, locally downloaded quantized models running on the Apple Silicon GPU/Neural Engine, or connects to user-hosted local endpoints (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:11434`).
  - **Custom Presets**: Create unlimited customizable prompts linked to designated keyboard shortcuts.
  - **No Cloud Required**: Text never leaves the computer. Works seamlessly without an active internet connection.
- **Pricing**: One-time purchase of $24.99 USD.

### App 5: WhisperType
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.hanncrest.com/whispertype/
- **Tagline**: Local voice dictation for Mac.
- **Category**: Speech Recognition & Accessibility Utility.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - **System-Wide Dictation**: Press Option-Space (`⌥Space`) from any text input field to begin high-accuracy speech-to-text transcription.
  - **Apple Neural Engine Acceleration**: Powered by OpenAI Whisper models optimized natively for Apple Silicon, providing fast transcription with low power consumption.
  - **Model Flexibility**: Supports multiple model tiers (Tiny, Base, Small, Large, and Large Turbo) depending on user accuracy needs and RAM capacity.
  - **Multi-Language Support**: Accurate speech-to-text across dozens of world languages and accents.
  - **100% Private & Offline**: Audio is transcribed in real-time in memory and inserted via macOS Accessibility API. Audio is never stored on disk or transmitted over the network.
- **Pricing**: One-time purchase of $19.99 USD.

---

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### General & Studio Questions
- **Q: Are HANNCREST apps available on the Mac App Store or direct download?**
  - A: Apps are offered both through the Mac App Store and direct downloads from hanncrest.com. Direct-download versions unlock advanced hardware-level diagnostics that standard App Store sandboxing restricts.
- **Q: Do HANNCREST apps have subscriptions?**
  - A: No. All HANNCREST applications use single, one-time payment licenses. Once purchased, users own the software forever.
- **Q: Do HANNCREST apps collect personal data?**
  - A: No. HANNCREST collects zero personal data, analytics, crash logs, or identifiers.

### Vitals FAQ
- **Q: Can Vitals monitor Apple Silicon thermal throttling?**
  - A: Yes. Vitals monitors CPU/GPU thermal sensors and fan RPMs directly on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- **Q: How does local LLM detection work in Vitals?**
  - A: Vitals inspects local system processes and ports for Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp runtimes to benchmark token generation speeds and VRAM consumption.

### Breeze FAQ
- **Q: Why does Breeze require Full Disk Access?**
  - A: Full Disk Access is required by macOS so Breeze can scan caches, application leftover files, and developer directories outside user space. All scanning is performed strictly locally.

### StealthShare FAQ
- **Q: Does StealthShare record video?**
  - A: No. StealthShare never records or streams display output. It creates native visual masks over selected application windows.

### Aura & WhisperType FAQ
- **Q: Do Aura and WhisperType require an internet connection?**
  - A: No. After the initial one-time model download, both Aura and WhisperType operate 100% offline.
